name: sensei_contract_forge_tutor
description: Contract with 4 can-signatures including parameterless and typed returns parses successfully
input:
type QueryResult
  answer: Text
  confidence_tier: Text
  sources_used: Number

type AssessmentResult
  passed: Bool
  prediction: Text
  expected: Text
  gap_topic: Text

contract ForgeTutor
  can query(question: Text) -> QueryResult
  can review(code: Text) -> Text
  can status() -> Text
  can assess_detailed(test_input: Text, expected: Text) -> AssessmentResult
